request:
镜头 s17：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-arch58）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['ENG broadcast camera', 'scan lines']）：Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，新闻摄像机手持，画面有扫描线和压缩噪点。黄昏的楼顶，一轮大得不正常的月亮压在城市上空，几个人站在楼顶抬头看。环境声：风声、远处的警报声、人群低低的议论声。
情绪：ominous, awed, uneasy
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide shot, shoulder-mounted news camera with an unsteady handheld drift
景深与虚实：Archival video softness throughout, the Moon's surface detail slightly smeared by compression.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival 2058 news footage on a shoulder camera: from a city rooftop at dusk, an enormous Moon hangs far too close and too large over the skyline; a few small figures on the roof look up at it in silence; in the far distance rises the blue plasma column of a planetary engine. Blocking lock: the huge Moon fills the upper centre of frame above the skyline; a few small silhouetted figures stand on the rooftop at frame lower left; the engine's plasma column rises far away at frame right.
Picture 2: the planetary engine exterior on the ice plain (location reference; role: location reference). Extreme wide exterior shot on the frozen surface of the Earth: a planetary engine the size of a mountain rises from an ice plain, a colossal industrial structure of steel and concrete, firing a blinding blue-white plasma column straight up into a black starry sky. Tiny lights of vehicles at its base give the scale, blowing snow, minus eighty degrees.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：wind on the rooftop, distant sirens, a low murmur of people
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens

[rules/move/searching-zoom] move
[ours/blur-memory] 虚实：记忆要模糊，信息要清楚

画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the archival 2058 news frame of a city rooftop at dusk from <Picture 1>, serving as composition, lighting and blocking reference. Shoulder-mounted news camera view from a rooftop: an enormous Moon hangs far too close and too large, filling the upper centre of frame above a dark skyline of towers; a few small silhouetted figures stand on the rooftop at frame lower left, seen from behind and slightly below, heads tipped back; far away at frame right the blue plasma column of a planetary engine rises straight up. Palette: murky crushed blue-black sky, hot clipped white around the Moon's rim, smeared red warning beacons on the skyline; the last dusk light sits low and flat on the roof concrete, rooftop vents and antenna masts break the skyline as dark shapes. No door plates, shop signs or any text. Blocking lock: huge Moon upper centre, small figures on the rooftop frame lower left, distant plasma column frame right, empty dark sky foreground upper left.
<Subject 2> is the planetary engine exterior on the ice plain from <Picture 2>, serving as location reference. Extreme wide frozen surface of the Earth: a planetary engine the size of a mountain rises from an ice plain, a colossal industrial structure of steel and concrete, firing a blinding blue-white plasma column straight up into a black starry sky; tiny vehicle lights at its base give the scale; blowing snow, minus eighty degrees. Layout: mountain-scale base structure on the plain, the plasma column vertical above it, drifting snow haze at ground level. Light: cold blue-white engine glow as the only strong source against a black sky. Materials: weathered steel plate, stained concrete, packed ice and snow. Palette: blue-white, steel grey, black.

summary:
Quoted archival 2058 broadcast news footage: on a city rooftop at dusk a handful of people stand with their backs to the camera and look up at a Moon that hangs far too large over the skyline, while the blue plasma column of a distant planetary engine rises at frame right. Nothing is said; the wind and distant sirens carry the whole eight seconds. The clip ends on the framing settling with the huge Moon above the skyline and the figures on the rooftop motionless, heads still tipped back.

<Subject 2> (appears in this shot): fully_preserved — environment, lighting and layout retained; the mountain-scale engine, its vertical blue-white plasma column and the frozen plain with blowing snow stay as described.

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 8.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide shot, shoulder-mounted ENG broadcast camera with one unsteady handheld drift, tilting slowly up and settling from a wide framing of the rooftop and the figures at frame lower left to a wider framing that holds the whole huge Moon at upper centre and the distant plasma column at frame right; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at start: the Moon fills the upper centre of frame, a few small silhouetted figures stand on the rooftop at frame lower left with their backs to camera, the blue plasma column of the planetary engine rises far away at frame right, the dark skyline runs between them. Start: the camera is already moving as the operator walks two short steps forward on the roof concrete, the horizon line seesawing, the auto iris hunting as the bright Moon rim blows out to clipped white; the figures at frame lower left stand still, coats and hair pulled sideways by the wind. Middle: one figure lifts a bare hand and points up at the Moon, another tilts his head further back, a third shifts his weight and puts a hand on the low parapet; the operator's searching zoom pushes a little into the group and then eases back out, edges of the frame softening as the zoom travels, red beacons on the skyline smearing to the right. End: the framing settles with the Moon enormous at upper centre, the figures at frame lower left motionless with heads tipped back, the plasma column still burning at frame right; one faint rolling noise bar drifts down the frame and the picture jitters slightly at the edge. Mood: ominous, awed, uneasy. Blur: archival video softness throughout, the Moon's surface detail slightly smeared by compression, the distant skyline and the plasma column dissolving into a hazy blue-white glow, while the silhouettes of the figures on the parapet stay readable. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Wind buffeting the rooftop and the camera microphone, a distant siren rising and fading across the city, a low murmur of people close to the microphone, a coat flapping, a hand brushing the camera body, faint tape hiss under everything; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
